name: Lakewood Center
summary: Lakewood Center is an established regional mall near Long Beach featuring over 225 retailers including Macy's, JCPenney, Target, and Costco, with convenient freeway access. The center combines shopping with entertainment through its 16-screen cinema, Round One complex, and diverse dining options ranging from food court favorites to full-service restaurants.
demographics: Lakewood Center serves a diverse, middle-income demographic in the Long Beach and Southeast Los Angeles County area, drawing families and value-conscious shoppers from surrounding communities. The trade area includes a mix of working-class and middle-class households with varied ethnic backgrounds, reflecting the multicultural nature of the greater Los Angeles region. Primary visitors include families with children seeking convenient one-stop shopping, young adults attracted to entertainment options like Round One and Starlight Cinemas, and budget-minded consumers drawn to big-box retailers like Target, Costco, and Home Depot. The center's location near major freeways (91, 605, and 405) expands its reach to commuters and regional shoppers seeking accessible, value-oriented retail options.
description: Lakewood Center stands as a cornerstone shopping destination in the Long Beach area, strategically positioned at the intersection of Lakewood Boulevard and Del Amo Boulevard with convenient access from three major freeways. This established regional mall has evolved into a comprehensive retail hub featuring over 225 stores, anchored by major department stores including Macy's and JCPenney, alongside big-box powerhouses like Target, Home Depot, and Costco. The center offers an impressive mix of national retailers ranging from fashion favorites like H&M and Victoria's Secret to electronics giant Best Buy, ensuring shoppers find everything they need under one roof. Beyond shopping, Lakewood Center has transformed into a true entertainment destination with its 16-screen Starlight Cinemas, Round One entertainment complex, and diverse dining options including California Pizza Kitchen, Outback Steakhouse, Luna Grill, and the trendy Dave's Hot Chicken. The mall's food court and full-service restaurants cater to every taste and occasion, making it a popular gathering place for families and friends throughout the Southeast Los Angeles County region.
